title: Inferno Venator Bow Sub 44 (OSRS)
summary: Gnomonkey shows an Inferno speedrun using the Venator bow that began badly but finished sub 44, beating his previous personal best of 46:07. The video is almost entirely live gameplay with sparse commentary; the description explains that the Venator bow replaces an Infernal cape switch and saves a lot of time but is hard to use.

outline.text: Starting the run, flying into the Inferno
Dealing with frustration; the run is at 2:26 on the clock early on and behind pace
Pacing and combat, a roughly 6:30 wave
Technical gameplay with chins and Venator bow angles

claims.text: Gnomonkey completed an Inferno speedrun in under 44 minutes with the Venator bow, even though the run started absolutely horribly.
Gnomonkey's previous Inferno personal best before this run was 46:07.
Gnomonkey says he was about a minute behind in the first three splits of this run, so it could have been a lot faster.
Early in the run the clock read 2:26 and Gnomonkey noted it was not even from misplays.
At the end of the run Gnomonkey reacts with disbelief and asks if anybody saw the time, confirming the sub 44 finish.
In his Inferno speedruns the Venator bow takes the place of an Infernal cape switch; Gnomonkey does not use a spec bar so he cannot currently use claws.
Gnomonkey calculates the Venator bow maxes 96 with the full 2 ricochets, and still maxes 69 with only 1 ricochet, which is higher than two Toxic blowpipe shots with higher accuracy.
Gnomonkey says the Venator bow saves a lot of time in the Inferno but is hard to use, and says it truly saved the day in this run.
Gnomonkey notes you kind of just have to guess with the Venator bow, since you cannot tell where the ricochet hit from the XP drop.
Gnomonkey streams Inferno speedruns like this one on his Twitch channel.
Gnomonkey does not use a spec bar in his Inferno speedruns, which is why he currently cannot use claws and uses the Venator bow instead.
